seoTitle: A new colleague has joined our team of testers: Alexis Leclercq - Q-Leap
body:
We are happy to welcome Alexis Leclercq to our team of testers as a Technical Test Consultant! He joined us just a few weeks ago and will be working on an assignment with one of our long-standing clients.

With a background in web development, Alexis changed careers in 2021 to become a tester. He has three years of experience in automated testing, mainly in the insurance sector. He joined us to work in a technically stimulating environment where expectations are clearly defined. What’s more, testing is his passion! Finding bugs and improving the quality of the user experience is a real challenge for him. For Alexis, every project is unique and pushes him to develop innovative solutions to automate tests efficiently. That is what he enjoys most about his work!

With his positive attitude, his natural calm and his desire to take on new challenges while growing in his role, we are delighted to welcome Alexis to our company. At Q-Leap, we are committed to bringing people like him, a passionate tester, into our team of enthusiasts. Thanks to Alexis, projects and new ideas come to life! Originally from Niort, France, he moved to Luxembourg to join us.

Welcome, Alexis!
